A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ATAS, and all supplied pages are readable. However, v2 ends after the references despite referring to an Appendix, whereas v1 includes supplementary Sections 6-13. Supplementary comparisons are therefore limited to what is included in the supplied PDFs.

before.justification: V1 reports original segmentation, detection, coherence and alignment results, with ablations and additional experiments in its supplement.

after.justification: V2 retains original segmentation and detection experiments and adds hyperparameter sensitivity results and an ImageNet accuracy diagnostic.

M1.justification: Both versions use similarity-weighted global-to-local distillation, relational local-to-local distillation, global-to-global distillation and mosaic augmentation. Equations 1-5 and the default loss weights remain unchanged; the new sensitivity experiments do not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: The training datasets and segmentation/detection task coverage remain unchanged. V2 additionally reports ImageNet classification accuracy when removing global-to-global distillation, extending evaluation to global recognition on an already-used dataset.

E2.justification: Table 3 adds CLIM and DenseVLM to the detection comparison; CLIM was previously cited but not included there. V1's supplementary comparison using original ClearCLIP is absent, while the modified ClearCLIP variant remains in Table 1.

E3.justification: Table 4c replaces mosaic-configuration controls with loss-weight and temperature settings, including LLD weight 1, GGD weight 0.01 and temperatures 0.1 and 10. The retained experiments' stated default training settings are unchanged; omitted supplementary details do not establish that those experiments were rerun differently.

E4.justification: The mosaic ablation is replaced by loss-weight and temperature sensitivity tests, accompanied by a new GGD-removal ImageNet diagnostic. V2 also omits the supplementary original-ClearCLIP architectural robustness comparison and additional qualitative cases. The loss-component and GLD-design ablations remain.

E5.justification: Neither PDF reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. V2's added experiments continue reporting point estimates.

E6.justification: Tables 1-2 and shared benchmark rows remain numerically unchanged. V2 adds comparator scores, sensitivity results and the reported ImageNet accuracy decrease from 67.25% to 40.92% without GGD. It omits supplementary Tables 6-8, including original-ClearCLIP results, ViT-L segmentation and OpenAI-CLIP detection results. Table 5's accuracy values and Figure 5's AUROC summaries remain represented in Figure 2.

T1.justification: ATAS's mathematical formulation in Equations 1-5 is unchanged. V2 omits the auxiliary dense-feature extraction definitions for ClearCLIP and MaskCLIP variants given in v1's supplementary Equations 6-11; neither version presents theoretical guarantees or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions and conclusion retain the same claims: unlabeled-image self-distillation jointly improves semantic coherence and fine-grained alignment, benefiting open-vocabulary segmentation and detection.

C2.justification: V2 replaces the mosaic-diversity interpretation with explanations of the segmentation/detection trade-off from LLD weighting and GGD's preservation of foundational knowledge. It also omits v1's supplementary explanation of feature-correspondence versus attention-based coherence measurements. The central coherence/alignment interpretation remains.

D1.justification: V2 omits essential supplementary documentation: mosaic resolutions and assembly, patch-label assignment and sampling, precise ablation evaluation settings, dense-feature extraction formulas and CAT-Seg architectural/training differences. Main-text optimizer, hardware, epochs and default hyperparameters remain, but do not replace these reproducibility details.

R1.justification: DenseVLM is newly cited, while six appendix-only references disappear, including ProxyCLIP and CLIPtrase. Section 4.1 more explicitly emphasizes PACL's paired-data dependence and CLIPSelf's coherence degradation, without substantially changing ATAS's overall positioning.

P1.justification: The supplementary narrative comprising Sections 6-13 is absent, and specific supplementary cross-references become unresolved generic Appendix pointers. The main section order remains, with localized ablation and related-work rewrites, an added acknowledgements paragraph and a corresponding-author designation.

P2.justification: V2 expands Table 3 and replaces Table 4c's mosaic display with a hyperparameter grid. Supplementary Tables 5-8 and Figures 5-9 are absent. Main Figures 1-4 remain, preserving some supplementary summaries and qualitative examples, but substantial visual documentation is lost.

improvement.justification: As supplied, v2 gains useful comparator coverage and sensitivity analysis but loses essential reproducibility information and substantial supporting evidence, including architectural robustness and additional-backbone results. Broad claims and references to the absent Appendix remain. These losses materially weaken the paper's verifiability and evidential completeness, outweighing the limited additions.
